test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Arvind bought an item under successive discount scheme having 20% and 25% discounts successively, and paid Rs. 6,000 as the bill. MRP of the item was:
solution:
**Given Data:**

First discount = 20%

Second discount = 25%

Final price = Rs. 6,000

**Concept:**

MRP = Final Price / (1 - First Discount/100) / (1 - Second Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

MRP = 6000 / (1 - 20/100) / (1 - 25/100)

⇒ MRP = Rs. 10,000

**Therefore, the MRP of the item was Rs. 10,000.**
